meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 6 — China deep dive. Densifies the bilateral economic, investment, border and political relationship beyond the Batch 5 trade and partnership nodes.

candidates.title: China FDI in Vietnam statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Planning and Investment / GSO related
candidates.description: Registered and realised FDI from China (and Hong Kong where separately reported). China ranks among the top sources by number of new projects and has risen into the top tier by capital in recent years; manufacturing and processing dominate.
candidates.notes: Investment-side densification of the China corridor. Complements the large trade relationship.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China trade structure (electronics, intermediates, agriculture)
candidates.description: Commodity composition of bilateral trade. Vietnam imports large volumes of intermediate goods, components and machinery from China; exports electronics, telephones, agricultural products and other goods. Structural deficit with China is a recurring feature.
candidates.notes: Commodity-structure densification of the China trade relationship.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China Border Economic Zones and cross-border cooperation
candidates.description: Border Economic Zones (BEZs) and Cross-Border Economic Cooperation Zones along the Vietnam–China land border (Lao Cai, Mong Cai, Dong Dang, Cao Bang and related pairs). Focus of infrastructure, trade facilitation and local economic development.
candidates.notes: Spatial and institutional densification of the land-border economic relationship.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China land border treaty and border management framework
candidates.description: Legal and institutional framework stemming from the 1999 Land Border Treaty and subsequent demarcation/management agreements. Provides the foundation for orderly border trade, BEZs and local cooperation.
candidates.notes: Foundational legal node for the land border.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China Community with a Shared Future framing
candidates.description: Elevated political framing (Community with a shared future that carries strategic significance) that sits above the Comprehensive Strategic Cooperative Partnership. Continuously referenced in joint statements and high-level visits.
referenced_by: Trade, FDI and border cooperation analysis

candidates.title: Vietnam–China infrastructure and railway connectivity projects
candidates.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and China / related
candidates.description: Priority cross-border infrastructure cooperation, including standard-gauge railway lines linking the two countries. Treated as strategic connectivity projects in joint statements.
referenced_by: Border Economic Zones and trade nodes
candidates.notes: Physical-connectivity densification of the bilateral relationship.

candidates.title: China-linked supply-chain and production-network framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade, FDI and industrial sources
candidates.description: Analytical and policy framing of Vietnam’s position in China-centred and China-linked regional production networks — especially electronics and intermediate goods. Captures both complementarity and strategic diversification pressures.
referenced_by: Electronics trade and China trade-structure nodes
USA export corridor and multi-vector strategy
candidates.notes: Value-chain framing node that links China inputs to Vietnam’s export performance (including to the USA).

candidates.title: Vietnam–China deep-dive densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MPI, customs, border and partnership sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding China FDI, detailed trade structure, Border Economic Zones, land-border treaty/management, Community with a Shared Future framing, infrastructure/railway connectivity, and China-linked supply-chain framing into a coherent deep bilateral layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier China trade, partnership, electronics, FDI and multi-vector series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the China deep-dive pass.
